script:
export const meta = {
  name: 'review-visibility-ui',
  description: 'Implement the UI and browser-test workstream (slices B and C) directly in the integrator checkout against the merged adapter and controller',
  phases: [{ title: 'Implement UI', detail: 'review panel, run inputs, finding-to-task links, mocks/seeds/specs' }],
}

const SPEC = '/tmp/claude-1000/-home-agentops-dev-md-manager-ultra/9ef1cac0-1832-43a8-bc1f-712f36914ef4/scratchpad/DESIGN_REVIEW_VISIBILITY.md'

const REPORT = {
  type: 'object',
  required: ['changed_files', 'tests_run', 'deviations', 'concerns', 'notes_for_integrator'],
  properties: {
    changed_files: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
    tests_run: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', required: ['command', 'result'], properties: { command: { type: 'string' }, result: { type: 'string' } } } },
    deviations: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
    concerns: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
    notes_for_integrator: { type: 'string' },
  },
}

phase('Implement UI')
const prompt = [
  'You are workstream U (UI and browser tests) of a three-workstream implementation. The other two workstreams (P: Python controller/export, S: server adapter) are FINISHED and already merged into your working directory, /home/agentops/dev/md-manager-ultra (run pwd to confirm; do not cd elsewhere). Work directly in this checkout; there is no worktree isolation. Do not commit, stash or push. node_modules is a symlink that already exists; Python is /home/agentops/dev/md-manager/.venv/bin/python (not needed for your work).',
  '',
  'STEP 0: read the design spec at ' + SPEC + ' in full (sections 0, 1, 2 and 5 are yours; section 4 describes the adapter that is now real). Then read contracts/projects/v1.ts, contracts/projects/examples.ts, contracts/projects/README.md, and the merged adapter in server/projects.ts (the projectReview/projectInputs functions and the review/inputs routes in server/projectRoutes.ts) so your seeds match what the real backend accepts: the export sections it validates are strict (see the reviewSectionSchema and inputsSectionSchema near the top of server/projects.ts).',
  '',
  'YOUR TASK: implement spec section 5 completely (5.1 through 5.5): the review panel on the review node (slice B), the run inputs (Assignment tab, run header facts, worker node Task / Exact prompt / Launch receipt / Reported-by-the-worker / Handoff / Stop panels), the finding-to-task links with the quote highlight hand-off (slice C), the API client additions, and the mocks, seeds, fixtures and the two new spec files with the nine new scenarios (review-verdict, review-blocked, review-legacy, paths-redacted, run-assignment, worker-inputs, finding-to-task, inputs-legacy, inputs-paths-redacted). Ownership: src/App.tsx, src/App.css, src/graph/**, src/projects/**, src/index.css, tests/project-workflows/**. Nothing else: never edit server/**, workflow/**, contracts/**, features/**, docs/**, package.json or the root playwright.config.ts (you may import src/document/Markdown.tsx but not edit it). If something outside your ownership blocks you, report it in "concerns" rather than changing it.',
  '',
  'Read src/projects/*.tsx, src/projects/api.ts, tests/project-workflows/*.ts and the existing scenarios in projects.spec.ts fully before changing anything; keep the six existing scenarios passing in BOTH phases. Because the real adapter is present, candidate mode (WORKFLOW_VERIFICATION_PHASE=candidate) must be fully green for all 15 scenarios, as must worker mode (mocks). Red-green discipline: write each new scenario first, watch it fail for the behavioural reason, then implement. Run at the end, one after the other (never two Playwright suites at once): npx --no-install playwright test --config=tests/project-workflows/playwright.config.ts ; then WORKFLOW_VERIFICATION_PHASE=candidate npx --no-install playwright test --config=tests/project-workflows/playwright.config.ts ; then npm run build ; npm run lint ; npm run test:unit ; and report exact counts. Keep the narrow-layout (420px) assertion in failed-and-paused passing: new panels must not overflow horizontally. Accessibility: headings, labelled tabs (role=tablist/tab/tabpanel with aria-selected/aria-controls), keyboard-operable toggles, and a mark element highlight with visible contrast in both colour schemes (use the App.css colour tokens; add new tokens to src/index.css if needed). Match the existing code style (no semicolons, single quotes, 2-space). The seed data must include the raw absolute path under the temporary root inside one finding message, one requirement quote (so its redaction is exercised too) and one completion summary, so that the two redaction scenarios can assert the literal string <path> in candidate mode and never see /tmp/ or /home/ in the rendered text.',
  '',
  'Your final answer must be the structured report (schema enforced); "changed_files" must be complete and "tests_run" must list every command above with its counts.',
].join('\n')

const report = await agent(prompt, { label: 'impl:ui', phase: 'Implement UI', schema: REPORT })
return report

tests_run.command: npx --no-install playwright test --config=tests/project-workflows/playwright.config.ts (baseline, before any change)
npx --no-install playwright test --config=tests/project-workflows/playwright.config.ts (red phase: tests/fixtures/mocks/seeds written, no UI yet)
tests_run.result: 9 failed, 6 passed (1.5m). The 9 failures were the nine new scenarios, each for a behavioural reason (no tablist 'Run views', no task-panel, no review-findings rows, no review-none / inputs-none); the six existing scenarios passed with the reworked fixtures.
exit 0 (after fixing an unused prop, moving reviewSummary to status.ts and replacing a `window` global in a spec callback)

tests_run.command: WORKFLOW_VERIFICATION_PHASE=candidate npx --no-install playwright test --config=tests/project-workflows/playwright.config.ts (final, real adapter + seeded runs)

tests_run.result: exit 0 (tsc -b + vite build, 448 modules, built in 652ms; pre-existing >500kB chunk warning only)

deviations: projects.spec.ts received a second edit beyond the run-count update (now 5, with data-status checks for run-blocked and run-legacy): the run-evidence scenario's result discovery now filters snapshot nodes to result_uri values containing '/results/'. The review node's result_uri is now the reviews route (in both phases), whose payload has no `artifacts`, so the old unfiltered discovery would have thrown.

Worker-mode fixtures now give launch_ui / launch_adapter a result_uri to the lane's worker result, matching what the real adapter projects (WORKER_OF includes the launch nodes). This keeps the 'required check -> executed check' links identical in both phases; run-evidence and failed-and-paused still pass.

Review panel fetch for exports without a review link: when the snapshot's review node has result_uri null and is not pending, the panel requests reviews/<max(attempt,1)> so the 404 REVIEW_NOT_FOUND path is genuinely exercised; pending review nodes show review-none without a request.

Highlight hand-off (spec 5.4): RunView keeps pendingHighlight and clears it through onHighlightApplied once the mark has been scrolled into view; the mark persists on that node because TaskPanel captures the quote at mount and NodeDetail is keyed by node id, so leaving the node drops it (navigating away also clears it). No setState-in-effect was needed, which keeps the react-hooks rules satisfied.

The Assignment tab's copy of the 'Inputs not recorded' sentence carries data-testid="assignment-inputs-none" (the header keeps inputs-none) so a page never has two identical test ids; the sentence text is the same.
reviewSummary lives in src/projects/status.ts rather than ReviewDetail.tsx because the react-refresh lint rule forbids non-component exports from component files.

Fixture variety: RUN_AWAITING's inputs are a manual-mode run (automatic: null) to exercise the mode branch, RUN_FAILED carries a failure_drill and an adapter lane with no completion/handoff and an unconfirmed stop, and RUN_BLOCKED has diff: null to exercise 'No diff artifact was recorded'. RUN_SUCCEEDED is the fully populated automatic run described in the spec.
A new shared helper module tests/project-workflows/support.ts serves the two new spec files; projects.spec.ts keeps its own local helpers (left as they were apart from the two edits above).

The `#check-<index>` links preventDefault and scroll/focus the executed check directly, because App.tsx's popstate handler rewrites a hash-only history entry (replaceState without the fragment); the href is kept for semantics and is what the test asserts.
src/App.tsx and src/graph/** were within ownership but needed no change.
concerns: git status shows docs/PRD_REVIEW_VISIBILITY.md modified and docs/HANDOFF_REVIEW_VISIBILITY.md untracked; those are not mine (docs/ is outside my ownership and I never touched it), presumably from another workstream or the orchestrator.

Playwright output directories were redirected to the scratchpad via MD_MANAGER_PROJECTS_OUTPUT for every run so no test-results/ directory was created in the checkout; the default output path in playwright.config.ts is unchanged.

The candidate-mode redaction assertions rely on the temp root being under /tmp (os.tmpdir()); on a machine with TMPDIR elsewhere the `/tmp/` regex would not catch a leak, though the `<path>` presence assertion still would. The seeded leak path is join(runDir, 'worktree-ui', 'test-results') under the temporary root.

Edge case (documented in code): a pending highlight targeting a node whose inputs never load stays pending until that node's task panel mounts or another finding link is clicked; harmless, since it only applies to the node the reader asked for.

The findings table sets min-width: 560px inside an overflow:auto wrapper so it scrolls within the detail panel at narrow widths instead of widening the page; the 420px overflow assertion is on the launch_ui node and passes, and the review node was checked visually in the candidate screenshots.
result.notes_for_integrator: Run the browser suite one phase at a time: `npx --no-install playwright test --config=tests/project-workflows/playwright.config.ts` then `WORKFLOW_VERIFICATION_PHASE=candidate npx --no-install playwright test --config=tests/project-workflows/playwright.config.ts` (15 scenarios each, no skips). Scenario IDs match features/run-inputs/policy.json: the six existing plus review-verdict, review-blocked, review-legacy, paths-redacted (review.spec.ts) and run-assignment, worker-inputs, finding-to-task, inputs-legacy, inputs-paths-redacted (inputs.spec.ts); every test attaches screenshot:<id>. Fixture design: tests/project-workflows/fixtures.ts defines the raw export sections (rawReviewSection / rawInputsSection, the exact shapes workflow/export_state.py 1.2.0 writes and server/projects.ts validates strictly, including argv+command, launch_token, background_id, failure_drill, policy_version and +00:00 timestamps) parameterised by a `leak` string. seed.ts passes a real absolute path under the run directory (one finding message, one requirement quote and the UI completion summary/prompt name it) so the real adapter's redactPaths is exercised; the mocks project the same sections with the literal `<path>` marker, so both phases render identical text and the redaction scenarios assert `<path>` present and no /tmp/ or /home/ in innerText. New runs: run-blocked (print reviewer, verdict blocked, review task error -> node failed, run failed, one P1 open + one P2 resolved) and run-legacy (1.0.0 export, integrated, values.review present but no sections -> 'not recorded' sentences). Data-testids follow spec 5.2/5.3 exactly (review-result, review-verdict, review-reviewer, review-bundle, review-summary, review-findings with section[data-disposition] and tr[data-testid=finding][data-severity][data-disposition][data-worker], finding-requirement, finding-task-link[data-lane], finding-task-unlinked, review-diff, review-none, tab-run/tab-assignment, run-inputs-facts, inputs-none, assignment, assignment-setup, assignment-worker[data-worker], assignment-task, task-panel, task-source, task-highlight (a <mark>), task-owned-paths, task-checks li[data-check-id], task-prompt, launch-receipt, worker-completion, worker-handoff, worker-stop) plus worker-inputs-none on worker nodes of legacy runs. The AppLink component now passes through extra anchor attributes (title, data-*). No files outside src/App.css, src/index.css, src/projects/** and tests/project-workflows/** were modified; nothing was committed.
